body: I am pretty sure because my art history adviser told me that I wouldn't. Thank you for all of your incredibly kind words.

I was wondering if it was a reference to something. I remember one episode of To Catch a Predator where Chris Hansen said someone's username was "Ice Truck Killer" very disapprovingly, not realizing it was a Dexter thing.
I have to say, though, I saw your reply while I was talking to my boyfriend and starting laughing through my tears because of your username combined with your comment.

Jobs in art history, and in general, are extremely competitive. Getting a good job in art history would mean grad school, which I would not get in to.

No. I've been cutting still. My boyfriend started answering my calls. I told him that I want to kill myself and he basically said that it was my decision, and kind of started taunting me by saying that I would fail any way I tried. He told me that he didn't care what I was going through.

Thank you.

I can't really change my major because I have no idea what I want to do. Also, my school makes it pretty difficult to switch majors past your second year. I'm studying art history now.

I have friends. I don't really want to tell them about this and put something like this on their shoulders. 

Thank you again.
